description: This file implements shared channel notification handling in Mattermost, including websocket event processing for content sync and invitations, managing remote clusters, and channel sharing logic.

classes.name: PlatformService
classes.description: Service class that handles shared channel websocket events and synchronization.

methods.name: SharedChannelSyncHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming websocket events related to shared channels, triggering content sync or invitations based on event type.

methods.name: isEligibleForEvents
methods.description: Checks if a websocket event is eligible for processing based on service status and event type.

methods.name: eventHasChannel
methods.description: Determines if a websocket event has an associated channel.

methods.name: syncServiceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the shared channel sync service is active.

methods.name: handleContentSync
methods.description: Performs synchronization of shared channel content, including remote cluster invitations and notifications.

methods.name: handleInvitation
methods.description: Processes shared channel invitations, sending invites to remote clusters.

methods.name: getUserFromEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a user object from websocket event data based on a specified key.

methods.name: findChannel
methods.description: Fetches a channel object by ID, with error handling if not found.
